description: KFLT v1 frozen vector for per-epoch decoy-seed derivation (PROTOCOL.md §2.8: deriveEpochDecoySeedHex) and deriveDecoys (padding.ts), for @forgesworn/tessera-kit. effectiveSeedHex = sha256(utf8("tessera-decoy:v1:") || bytes(decoySeedHex) || u64be(epoch)); decoysHex = deriveDecoys(effectiveSeedHex, decoyCount) = [sha256(bytes(effectiveSeedHex) || LE32(i)) for i in 0..decoyCount). Independently hand-checked via node:crypto at generation time (see scratchpad/gen-vectors.mjs) — not purely self-referential against this package's own @noble/hashes dependency.
